descriptions.d31i_game_stats_message_80109370: Game stats message handler: start through the base handler (0x80004005 on failure), appends the Stats.DestString text, flushes and clears counts, tallies matches, applies score changes (+3, +1, +10 and -3, -7), expands, sets or clears the active flag at +120, then forwards to the base handler.
